history.note: test corrected in its own phase; reviewed by the inspector and the human

requirement_quote: When a scoped register write function is called, the RCC LL driver shall change only the bit named for that function in RCC_CR.HSION, RCC_CR.HSEON, RCC_AHB1ENR.GPDMA1EN, RCC_AHB1ENR.ADC12EN, RCC_AHB1RSTR.GPDMA1RST or RCC_AHB1RSTR.ADC12RST and preserve all other bits of that register.
summary: Original TCHECKs referenced Boolean accumulators, hiding named register fields from observation. Added direct register-field and query expressions to existing numbered checks, retaining all accumulated assertions and expected values. Initial run passed 21 tests but verified only 4 requirements.
